message.content: {"action":"change_interpolation","reason":"The only evaluated configuration meeting the 8-LSB quality bar is the LUT/linear/256-depth/16-bit case at 1584.6 um², while CORDIC alternatives are both failing and much larger. Switching interpolation has one legal unvisited neighbor and may improve accuracy at a given phase precision without the area jump seen in CORDIC, so it is the best remaining tradeoff between numerical quality and mapped area."}
